location_anchors.prompt_summary: Single segmental arch stone bridge constructed from textured grey limestone blocks spanning across the calm Vère river. Surrounded by lush green forested hills and dense riverbank trees. The pristine water surface reflects the arch to form a complete symmetrical eye shape.

Close-up of historic grey limestone masonry blocks tightly fitted together with hand-dressed hot-mixed lime mortar joints. Fine hand-chiseled tooling marks and subtle natural mineral grain are visible across the uniform light grey stone surfaces.
Traditional cobblestone path running along the upper deck of the stone arch bridge, flanked by low limestone parapets. Surrounded by overhang canopy trees under soft overcast natural light.
Ancient grey limestone quarry outcrop upstream in the river valley. Exposed horizontal rock strata layers feature raw fine-grained limestone beds along a gravelly river bank.
